verdict.rationale: Groq's billing FAQ says paid accounts can 'Set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts', which covers both caps and alerts. Spend Limits are listed among the benefits unlocked by upgrading, so this appears limited to paid tiers. The evidence is a single FAQ bullet with no detail on how the limit behaves. missing for 10: confirmation that a cap hard-stops requests rather than only alerting, documentation of thresholds and alert configuration, per-key or per-project scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: Spend Limits: Set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts
Immediately after upgrading, you unlock several benefits: Higher Token Limits... Flex Service Tier... Batch Processing... Spend Limits
